# Premium Seller Morning Brief
## June 15, 2026

---

### 1. MARKET CONTEXT

Strong risk-on session with SPY +1.96% and QQQ +3.16%, while VIX dropped -7.81% to 16.3, signaling compressed volatility despite elevated HV ranks across tech names. QQQ's HV rank at 100 and multiple high-momentum names (AMD +6.94%, NVDA +3.54%, HOOD +7.95%) suggest recent realized vol hasn't fully priced out yet. **Environment is FAVORABLE for premium selling** — sell into strength while IV remains elevated on individual names, though be selective given the rapid VIX compression.

---

- **VIX compression warning:** -7.81% drop to 16.3 suggests premium will decay faster than usual; favor shorter DTEs (7-17) and be prepared for rapid theta acceleration

- **Tech momentum reversal risk:** AMD's 6.94% single-day spike on HV rank 66 signals potential exhaustion; if QQQ reverses sharply, high-beta names (AMD, NVDA, HOOD) will see accelerated drawdowns — monitor daily for adjustment triggers
